P: Serve the mains when the cabbie who speaks no English drives them nowhere.
S: Grimm's disguise for the bank job

edition.tagline: The bank job was easy. Leaving New York is hard.
edition.cue: Serve the mains when the cabbie who speaks no English drives them nowhere.

s.note: Cherry tomatoes filled with basil and lemon whipped feta.
s.how: Cut the tops off 24 cherry tomatoes and scoop out the seeds. Blitz 150g feta with a handful of basil, the zest of 1 lemon and 2 tbsp olive oil until smooth. Pipe into the tomatoes and top each with a small basil leaf. A red nose for every guest.

s.note: Butter-roasted peanuts with chilli and smoked paprika.
s.how: Melt 20g butter and toss through 300g salted peanuts with 1/2 tsp chilli flakes and 1 tsp smoked paprika. Spread on a tray and roast at 170C for 10 minutes. Cool for 5 minutes and serve in small bowls.

m.note: Turkey and Swiss kaiser rolls wrapped tight in paper.
m.how: Split 4 kaiser rolls, spread with 80g mayonnaise and 1 tbsp mustard. Fill with 400g sliced turkey, 8 slices Swiss cheese, shredded iceberg lettuce and 2 sliced tomatoes, and season with salt and pepper. Wrap each tightly in paper and cut in half.

w.note: Jam sponge in white buttercream with a piped clown face and cherry nose.
w.how: Split a 400g sponge cake and fill with 100g raspberry jam. Beat 200g butter with 400g icing sugar and spread all over the cake. Tint a little leftover buttercream and pipe a clown face on top, then press a maraschino cherry in for the nose.

d.note: Cold lager in plastic cups, a toast to leaving New York.
d.how: Chill four 375ml bottles of lager in the fridge for at least two hours. Pour into plastic cups and toast to finally getting out of New York, before anything else goes wrong.
